import 'dart:math';

List<int> parseMusic(String musicString) {
  final List<String> notes = ['C', 'D', 'E', 'F', 'G', 'A', 'B', 'C#', 'Db'];
  int index = 0;
  List<int> result = [];
  
  while (index < musicString.length) {
    if (musicString[index] == '#') {
      // Handle sharp
      result.add(1);
      index += 2; 
    } else if (musicString[index] == 'b') {
      // Handle flat
      result.add(-1);
      index += 2; 
    } else if (musicString[index].toUpperCase() == 'X' && index + 1 < musicString.length && musicString[index+1] != '_') {
      // Handle extended note, e.g., X_
      result.add(0); // Placeholder for extension
      index += 2;
    } else if (musicString[index] == '_') {
      // Handle rest
      result.add(0);
      index++;
    } else {
      String noteChar = musicString[index];
      int noteIndex = notes.indexOf(noteChar.toUpperCase());
      
      if (noteIndex != -1) {
        result.add(noteIndex);
        index++;
      } else {
        throw FormatException('Invalid character in music string');
      }
    }
  }

  return result;
}

      factors.add(2);

int maxFill(List<List<int>> grid, int capacity) {

    int currentMax = 0;
    
    // Iterate from bottom to top for this column
    for (int i = rows - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      currentMax += grid[i][col];

        currentMax = 0;
        maxValues[i] = max(maxValues[i], 1); // Mark as at least one row filled
      } else if (currentMax == capacity) {
        maxValues[i] = max(maxValues[i], 1); // Fill exactly one row
      }
    }
  }

  if (arr.isEmpty || arr.length == 1) return 0;
  
  int left = 0, right = arr.length - 1;

  while (left < right) {
    while (left < right && arr[left] % 2 != 0) ++left;
    while (left < right && arr[right] % 2 == 0) --right;
    
    if (left < right) {
      int temp = arr[left];
      arr[left] = arr[right];
      arr[right] = temp;
      ++left;
      --right;
    }
  }

  }

bool isEqualToSumEven(int n) {

  }
  return sum == n && sum != n * 2;

String strongestExtension(String className, List<String> extensions) {
  if (extensions.isEmpty) return '';
  
  String getStrongestExtension(List<String> list) {
    int calculateScore(String extension) {
      var parts = extension.split('.');
      String extName = parts[parts.length - 1];
      int letterValues = 0;
      
      for (var char in extName.codeUnits) {
        letterValues += char;
      }
      
      // Calculate the strength as the sum of ASCII values
      return letterValues; 
    }

    Map<int, List<String>> groupByStrength = {};
    
    for (var ext in list) {
      int score = calculateScore(ext);
      if (!groupByStrength.containsKey(score)) {
        groupByStrength[score] = [];
      }
      groupByStrength[score].add(ext);
    }
    
    List<MapEntry<int, List<String>>> sortedEntries = groupByStrength.entries.toList()
      ..sort((a, b) => b.key.compareTo(a.key));
    
    final strongestGroup = sortedEntries.firstWhere(
      (entry) => entry.value.isNotEmpty,
      orElse: () => const {},
    );
    
    return strongestGroup.values.firstOrNull ?? "";
  }
  
  return getStrongestExtension(extensions).toLowerCase();
}
